### iliad-111 (17.288–383)

| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ζῆν’ ὕπατον μήστωρα μάχης ἐπιτάρροθον εἶναι (17.339) | "Zeus, highest counsellor of battle, is a helper" | "Zeus, the highest master of battle, is a helper" | "highest counsellor" in `i` (kept for μήστωρ alone, 8.22); follows μήστωρες ἀϋτῆς "masters of the battle-cry" (4.328) and μήστωρα φόβοιο "master of flight" (12.39) where a genitive follows; ἐπιτάρροθος keeps "helper" and the note says whose helper is not stated |
| ὑπὲρ Διὸς αἶσαν (17.321) | "beyond Zeus’ due measure" | "beyond the share Zeus had allotted" | "against fate", "beyond fate" (αἶσα is not μοῖρα / μόρος); follows κατ’ αἶσαν … ὑπὲρ αἶσαν "in due measure … beyond it" (3.59) |
| ὑπὲρ θεόν (17.327) | "beyond a god" | "in defiance of a god" (+ note: sense is "against a god’s will") | "against a god" alone, "even if a god opposes" (each picks one reading) |
| ἐπιοσσομένω (θάνατον καὶ φύζαν ἑταίρων, 17.381) | "foreboding" | "foreboding" (+ note: ἐπιόσσομαι is both "look at" and "forebode") | "dreading", "eyeing", "fearing"; follows κάκ’ ὀσσόμενος "evils foreboding" (1.105) |
| φύζα (17.381) | "panic" | "panic" | "rout", "flight" (kept for φόβος); follows φύζα "panic" (14.140) |
| ἄσπετον (adverbial, ἄσπετον οὐδὲ μάχεσθε, 17.332) | "boundlessly" | "beyond all measure" | "immensely", "terribly"; the table’s ἄσπετος is "boundless" and the adverb keeps that stem |
| πορφυρέῳ (αἵματι … πορφυρέῳ, 17.360–361) | "purple" | "purple" | "dark", "crimson", "red"; the table’s πορφυρέη "purple" (of cloth and sea) kept for blood |
| ὑπερδέα δῆμον ἔχοντας (17.330) | "holding a people fearless" | "holding a people that was without fear" (+ note: ὑπερδέα rare, sense not certain) | "unafraid" alone, "a people beyond fear"; each decides the uncertain word |
| αὐλός (παρ’ αὐλὸν, 17.297) | "the socket" | "the socket" (+ note: socket of the spear-head or channel of the wound, not known) | "tube", "pipe", "the opening" |
| ἔχοντο (πρὸ δὲ δούρατ’ ἔχοντο, 17.355) | "were held" | "were held out in front" (+ note: shade of the middle not certain) | "clung", "held fast", "the spears bristled" |
| ὑπερμενέων ἐπικούρων (17.362) | "allies of surpassing strength" | "allies of surpassing strength" | "mighty", "proud"; follows ὑπερμενής "exceeding-strong" / "of surpassing strength" (13.205) |
| ἐξάλμενος (προμάχων ἐξάλμενος ἔστη, 17.342) | "leaping out" | "leaping out" | "springing forth", "bounding"; ἐξάλλομαι keeps "leap" |
| μετ’ Ἀστεροπαῖον ἀριστεύεσκε μάχεσθαι (17.351) | "next after Asteropaeus used to be the best at fighting" | "next after Asteropaeus he used to be the best at fighting" | "second only to", "after Asteropaeus the best"; follows ἀριστεύεσκε μάχεσθαι "used to be the best at fighting" (16.551) |
| φίλα φρεσὶ μήδεα εἰδώς (17.325) | "knowing kindly counsels in his mind" | "a man who knew kindly counsels in his mind" (+ note: φίλα "kindly" or "his own") | "knowing friendly thoughts", "wise in heart"; follows θεῶν ἄπο μήδεα εἰδώς "who knew counsels from the gods" (6.12) |
| ἐπῴχετο … πολλὰ κελεύων (17.356) | "went about … giving many orders" | "went round … giving many orders" | "ordered much", "urging"; ἐποίχομαι keeps "go about" (1.383) |
